summary: Shows a sample directory layout with per-environment inventory files, group_vars and host_vars, optional library/module_utils/filter_plugins, top-level site and tier playbooks, and a tasks directory; moving playbooks into a subdirectory requires setting roles_path.
questions: What directory layout should my Ansible project use?
Where do I put custom modules and filter plugins in a project?
If I move my playbooks into a playbooks/ folder, how will Ansible find roles?
Where should group_vars and host_vars live?

answer_card.title: Sample Ansible directory layout
answer_card.answer_md:
```console
production          # inventory for production
staging             # inventory for staging
group_vars/
   group1.yml
host_vars/
   hostname1.yml
library/            # custom modules (optional)
module_utils/       # custom module_utils (optional)
filter_plugins/     # custom filters (optional)
site.yml            # main playbook
webservers.yml
dbservers.yml
tasks/
    webservers-extra.yml
```

By default Ansible expects roles in a `roles/` directory next to your playbooks. If you move playbooks into `playbooks/`, set `roles_path` in `ansible.cfg`.
